notes.title: Next Fest Live Stream
notes.content:
Come join us at our [b]2nd demo livestream[/b] of SPREAD!

We will be playing the demo (several times!) to show you this mysterious world we've built! Explore the creepy Stone Vein Hot Spring Hotel with Little Viny. Help her navigate through the secret passages and death traps, and lead her to the heart of the dark secrets of this disturbing hotel.

[h3]The livestream will be at 8 PM, October 8 Pacific Time.
[/h3]

See you there in the chat! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/s5N2qNPBzk]Discord[/url] community for more discussion too!

[h3]About SPREAD[/h3]
SPREAD is a horror puzzle and platformer game where you play as a little girl named Viny. Dark, eerie hand-drawn visuals, together with many puzzles and collectables bring to life a mysterious, creepy hotel with twisted secrets.

[list]
[*] Hand-drawn visuals that provide an immersive experience into a dark, eerie world. Molds on the walls, secret passages hidden in the vents, a human head in a box... What's waiting for you in the next room?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/e621a38449f2c52015b676b0ed62fd5477e6261a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/f3609f1fbcdcbacfeea20af568ca9decddd3f821.jpg[/img]

[*] Original puzzles based on Viny's abilities to control vine plants. Control the vines and make them grow to interact with your surroundings to navigate through hidden rooms and confront danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/e7e90f0932d1410f58decc0e85b0567a00c52c8a.gif[/img]

[*] Collectable items that reveal the secrets of this disturbing hotel. As you explore the surroundings, you will find items that help you piece together the story, for example diaries of hotel staff, trinkets left behind by former guests and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/23da8425247f6f33247929749e812b68a928e212.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Play SPREAD the horror puzzle platformer!
notes.content:
SPREAD is a horror puzzle and platformer game where you play as a little girl named Viny. Dark, eerie hand-drawn visuals, together with many puzzles and collectables bring to life a mysterious, creepy hotel with twisted secrets. 

Little Viny was brought to the Stone Vein Hot Spring hotel by her mother, in the hope of finding a cure for her strange disease. This disease also gave Viny a special power to control vine plants. On the first night there, however, woken up by a loud noise, Viny found her mother missing, and the hotel turning into a death trap...

[h3]Features: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Hand-drawn visuals that provide an immersive experience into a dark, eerie world. Molds on the walls, secret passages hidden in the vents, a human head in a box... What's waiting for you in the next room?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/e621a38449f2c52015b676b0ed62fd5477e6261a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/f3609f1fbcdcbacfeea20af568ca9decddd3f821.jpg[/img]

[*] Original puzzles based on Viny's abilities to control vine plants. Control the vines and make them grow to interact with your surroundings to navigate through hidden rooms and confront danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/e7e90f0932d1410f58decc0e85b0567a00c52c8a.gif[/img]

[*] Collectable items that reveal the secrets of this disturbing hotel. As you explore the surroundings, you will find items that help you piece together the story, for example diaries of hotel staff, trinkets left behind by former guests and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685525/23da8425247f6f33247929749e812b68a928e212.png[/img]
[/list]

Let us know what you think of the game via Steam or [url=https://discord.com/invite/s5N2qNPBzk]Discord[/url]! Your feedback will help us keep polishing and improving the game!
